# Pseudo-Classes

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Pseudo-Classes

Pseudo-classes style specific states or positions of elements. They are preceded by a :.

For example, you can style a button only when it's hovered (state) using the pseudo-class :hover.

```html
1<a href="#">This is an important message.</a>
```

```css
1a:hover {
2    color: red;
3}
```

Browser Output

![Pseudo-Selectors](data:image/png;base64,)

The red color is applied only when the user hovers over the element.
